messages:
jordan: FYI ran the nightly 8-node TP scale test with the new kernel-selector + batching heuristics. Repeated hangs/timeouts around step ~420, ranks 3/6/7 diverged

jordan: log snippet:
```
[rank=3] ERROR rendezvous: missed heartbeat (t=37s)
[rank=6] WARN kvcache: evict in-progress, pad mismatch
[master] ERROR allreduce: timeout waiting for 8 peers
```

jordan: repro cmd: ./scripts/run_scale_test --nodes 8 --tp 2 --seq 2048 --microbatch 16 --profile p99

anya: thanks — do we have per-rank timelines? sounds like kernel switch while an allreduce is inflight.

sam: grabbing perf traces now, uploading flamegraphs to http://short.link/fg-2312

taylor: ive seen something similar after autotuner changed the microbatch heuristic — it picked different microbatch counts per-device which changed padding and kernel choices.

anya: theory: kernel-selector picks a different kernel variant based on per-device microbatch/seq -> descriptor mismatch across ranks -> comm mismatch -> hang.

jordan: enabling HEARTBEAT_REPLAY=1 moved the failure from step 420 -> 510 but we still hit a hang later.

sam: per-rank timeline shows rank 3 stuck in WAIT_ALLREDUCE for 37s while others moved on. comm bytes snapshot shows a 0-length payload at that window.

taylor: quick patch idea to avoid switching kernels mid-iteration (pseudo):
```diff
- if (score(v) < best) select(v)
+ if (score(v) < best && !kvcache.in_flight()) select(v)
```

anya: also try stabilizing microbatch choice across workers: set AUTOTUNER_FIXED_MICROBATCH=16 so everyone makes the same decision.

sam: test matrix i'm running:
- baseline (no autotune)
- autotune but KERNEL_SELECTOR_LOCK=1
- autotune + HEARTBEAT_REPLAY
will post results in ~15m.

infra-bot: perf-job #4821 finished: nodes=8, runtime=02:14:31, failures=1

jordan: one more data point: enabling KVCACHE_STRICT_PAD=1 eliminated the mismatch in our run. suggests padding mismatch is the root cause.

anya: if padding is the cause, we also need to ensure allreduce ops use consistent tensor shapes even during kernel swap.

taylor: agreed. plan: (1) patch kernel selector to avoid mid-iteration swaps; (2) enforce global microbatch/pad policy at startup; (3) add telemetry to detect zero-byte allreduces and auto-fallback.

sam: i'll open a PR for (1) and add a repro harness that toggles eviction timing.

jordan: assigning to @sam @taylor. tagging @eng-sre for monitoring alerts next 24h.

eng-sre: ack — will watch. adding alert rule for 'allreduce_zero_bytes' and will page if seen >3 in 30m.

anya: short-term mitigations: AUTOTUNER_FIXED_MICROBATCH, KVCACHE_STRICT_PAD, KERNEL_SELECTOR_LOCK. long-term: kernel selector stability + better KV cache eviction coordination.

sam: updated diag run logs -> no hang in 3/3 with KERNEL_SELECTOR_LOCK=1 + KVCACHE_STRICT_PAD=1 :tada: 

jordan: great. i'll consolidate notes and add to the incident tracker. thanks team :thumbsup:
